notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing a Food.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure artifact token, a tapped Clue artifact token and a tapped Food artifact token.
When the tokens enter the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers three times, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the ability from step 1.
Repeat.
